I've built the LRU cache simulator in `src/main.cpp`, and `build.sh` compiles it with `-O2` to `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases.

- **Design:** a linked list keeps entries in order from most to least recently used, and a hash map points from each key to its entry. That makes `SET`, `GET`, `DEL` and `SIZE` O(1) expected time. It only uses the standard library.
